description: This PHP class 'WorkShiftDao' provides data access methods for managing 'WorkShift' entities, including CRUD operations, listing, filtering, and managing associations with employees within the OrangeHRM system.

classes.name: WorkShiftDao
classes.description: Data Access Object for 'WorkShift' entities, providing methods for retrieving, saving, updating, and deleting work shifts and their associations with employees.

methods.name: getWorkShiftById
methods.description: Retrieves a WorkShift entity by its ID. Returns null if not found.

methods.name: getExistingWorkShiftIds
methods.description: Returns a list of existing WorkShift IDs from a given list.

methods.name: getWorkShiftList
methods.description: Returns a list of WorkShift entities based on filtering parameters.

methods.name: getWorkShiftListPaginator
methods.description: Provides a paginator object for listing WorkShifts with filtering, sorting, and pagination.

methods.name: getWorkShiftCount
methods.description: Returns the count of WorkShifts matching the filtering parameters.

methods.name: saveWorkShift
methods.description: Persists a WorkShift entity and associated employee shifts within a transaction.

methods.name: saveEmployeeWorkShift
methods.description: Associates employees with a work shift by creating EmployeeWorkShift entities.

methods.name: updateWorkShift
methods.description: Updates a work shift and its associated employees, managing additions and deletions.

methods.name: getEmployeeListByWorkShiftId
methods.description: Retrieves a list of employees associated with a specific work shift.

methods.name: deleteExistingEmployees
methods.description: Removes associations between employees and a work shift.

methods.name: deleteWorkShifts
methods.description: Deletes multiple work shifts by their IDs.
